description.value: Country Grocer Salt Spring Island is a 28,000-square-foot destination market conveniently located at Ganges Village Marketplace in the heart of Ganges, serving both locals and visitors since the chain's founding in the 1980s. The store features a vibrant produce section with organic and locally grown selections, full deli, bakery, sushi, and meat/seafood departments, and an on-site pharmacy. An in-store Café offers fresh coffee, hot breakfast sandwiches, and casual lunch — useful for cyclists restocking or refuelling in Ganges.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fully corroborates the OSM record: address (374 Lower Ganges Rd, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2V7), phone (250-537-4144), and URL all match. The site confirms this is a 28,000-sq-ft supermarket with an in-store Café serving hot food, and a full produce/deli/bakery/meat/seafood offering. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, ice, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM community field is set to 'Chemainus' but this store is located on Salt Spring Island; the community tag appears to reflect Country Grocer's warehouse/distribution hub in Chemainus, not the store's own community. May cause incorrect geographic grouping in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A large, well-established full-service supermarket with a café in the commercial heart of Ganges, Salt Spring Island — a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists on the island.
